d:
Patna is one of the oldest cities in the world, with people inhabiting it for over a thousand years. In this episode of India With Elli Bihar Edition, Elli AvrRam takes you on a journey back in time and on a spiritual quest.
Elli visits some Historic & Spiritual places in Patna.
Bihar Museum
Patna Sahib Gurudwara
Patan Devi Temple
Agam Kuan
Gol Ghar
First up is the Bihar Museum, a treasure trove of ancient artifacts that tell the story of Bihar's past in a fascinating way.
